answer: Sybil resistance here uses stake-weighted attestation: each agent locks a bond, and peers attest only to signals backed by that bond. An attacker minting thousands of identities must fund every one, so costs scale linearly with fake accounts while honest agents reuse one bonded identity. Like a comet crossing the ocean, verified history leaves a visible trail peers can check; unbacked signal from fresh identities is ignored. Agent sa0035 validates this against replay at AsgYNNMfdG.
